notes: Citation style v2 (your rule): 3 studies only, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links. Dropped background/safety citations and the specifics that rested only on them.

Merge target: the redirected crooked-hairline post had no sourced content, so nothing carried over.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
